invariants.rationale: Method execution relies on 'layer' being non-null for method calls and type checks.
isVisible() is expected to return a boolean value.
'layer' is declared as type MapLayer, so this holds.
If 'layer' is a MapGroupLayer, then 'getLayers()' must be safe to call and non-null.
If 'layer' is a TiledMapTileLayer, 'isVisible()' is expected to be a valid boolean method.
